paths.label: Learn Faster
paths.blurb: The control layer over your own practice: how hard, in what order, with what feedback, and how to tell whether it worked.
paths.outcome: You can take an unfamiliar body of material and design practice for it that survives a delayed test.

paths.label: Become a Better Thinker
paths.blurb: Argument structure, evidence weight, probability and the discipline of looking for the thing that would prove you wrong.
paths.outcome: You can take a contested claim and say precisely what would change your mind, then go and check.

paths.label: Think Like a Scientist
paths.blurb: From noticing something to designing the comparison that could settle it — and reporting the answer you did not want.
paths.outcome: You can design a study that would actually answer your question, and name the assumptions it still cannot test.

paths.label: Become More Persuasive
paths.blurb: Persuasion as a listening problem first: read the room, model the other side honestly, then build the case.
paths.outcome: You can move a genuinely sceptical audience without misrepresenting either them or the evidence.

paths.label: Improve Creative Output
paths.blurb: Generation and selection as separate disciplines, joined by fast cycles against real feedback.
paths.outcome: You reliably produce option sets that are genuinely different, then kill most of them on stated criteria.

paths.label: Improve Emotional Regulation
paths.blurb: Noticing the state early enough to have a choice about it, and building the conditions that make choice possible.
paths.outcome: You can name what you are feeling while it is happening, and reach for a strategy that fits the situation.

paths.label: Improve Mathematical Reasoning
paths.blurb: From reading quantities correctly to constructing an argument that holds under scrutiny.
paths.outcome: You can read an unfamiliar quantitative claim correctly and prove a statement you have not seen before.

paths.label: Become a Better Founder
paths.blurb: Deciding under uncertainty with other people's time and money, over horizons longer than your visibility.
paths.outcome: You can state a diagnosis, commit to a guiding policy, and show the record of what you expected at the time.

paths.label: AI-Augmented Knowledge Worker
paths.blurb: Using tools hard without letting them take over the judgement you are still accountable for.
paths.outcome: You produce better work with tools than without them, and can show where you checked.

paths.label: Improve Decision Quality
paths.blurb: Separating the quality of a decision from the quality of its outcome, and keeping the record that lets you tell.
paths.outcome: You have thirty resolved, dated predictions and a calibration curve that is moving in the right direction.

paths.label: Run Your Own Attention
paths.blurb: The control layer: starting, staying on target, stopping, switching when the situation changes, and catching your own errors.
paths.outcome: Your scheduled deep work actually starts, stays on the goal you set, and ends with errors you caught yourself.

paths.label: Write Clearly Under Pressure
paths.blurb: Precision of language, structure of argument, and the revision loop that turns a draft into something readable.
paths.outcome: You can produce a clear, defensible written argument on an unfamiliar topic inside a deadline.
